d: Short, messy, raven-black hair with choppy bangs frames a youthful face with narrow, olive-green eyes and a neutral expression. The build is petite and slender, dressed in a complex layered outfit featuring a white sleeveless top, an olive-green wrap, and a brown fringed skirt, all accented by an orange and brown patterned scarf. A silver mechanical pouch is strapped to the waist, and the look is completed with black fingerless gloves and chunky black boots. The figure carries a long wooden staff topped with a large, ornate metallic head adorned with cascading white tassels.
